name: search_opportunities
description:
Search active SAM.gov contract opportunity notices: solicitations, combined synopses, presolicitations, sources sought, special notices, award notices, and justifications.

All filters combine. Keyword search covers titles and full descriptions. By default, only the latest version of each amended notice is included. Notices whose response deadline has passed are left out, except award notices and justifications; notices with no deadline are also included. Set include_past_deadlines to true to include other past-deadline notices. Results are sorted by soonest deadline, with notices that have no deadline last. Returns up to 100 notices per call with the total match count; use offset to page. Use get_opportunity for a notice's full description and contacts.

Data is SAM.gov's public daily file of active notices, not live SAM.gov. Archived notices and attachments are not included.

keywords.description: Words that must all appear in the title or full description. Put exact phrases in double quotes, e.g. zero trust "cloud migration". Word endings are matched loosely (bridge matches bridges).

notice_types.description: Current notice types to include. Omit for all types.

naics_codes.description: NAICS codes or prefixes (2 to 6 digits); a prefix such as 5415 matches every code under it.

psc_codes.description: Product and service codes or prefixes, e.g. D3 or R425.

set_aside_codes.description: SAM.gov set-aside codes, e.g. SBA (total small business), 8A, SDVOSBC, WOSB, HZC. NONE means the notice says no set-aside was used.

agency.description: Text matched against the department, sub-tier, and office names, e.g. Army, Veterans Affairs, NSWC Dahlgren. Field activities post under their own office names, so a command name matches only its headquarters office (NAVSEA matches NAVSEA HQ, not NSWC or NUWC offices).

place_of_performance_state.description: Two-letter state code for the place of performance. Most notices leave the place of performance blank, so results also report how many more notices have a contracting office in that state (see office_state).

office_state.description: Two-letter state code of the contracting office. Filled in on nearly every notice, but an office's state is not always where the work happens.

deadline_from.description: Earliest response deadline date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the deadline's own time zone.

include_past_deadlines.description: Include notices whose response deadline has already passed. SAM.gov keeps notices active for a while after the deadline; by default they are left out. Award notices and justifications are always included, even when they list a past deadline, and so are notices with no deadline.

include_earlier_versions.description: Include earlier versions of amended notices. SAM.gov's file lists every version of a notice as its own row; by default only the latest version of each is included.

sort.description: deadline: soonest response deadline first. newest: most recently posted first. relevance: best keyword match first (needs keywords).

name: get_opportunity
description:
Get one SAM.gov notice in full: description, response deadline, set-aside, NAICS and PSC codes, place of performance, contracting office, points of contact, award details for award notices, and the public sam.gov link. Also lists other active notices with the same solicitation number, such as earlier versions, amendments, or awards (with awardee and amount).

Pass the 32-character notice ID from search results, or a solicitation number (returns its most recently posted current notice, preferring the solicitation over award notices and justifications). Attachments are not retrieved; open the sam.gov link for them.

solicitation_number.description: Solicitation number, used when notice_id is not given.

name: summarize_opportunities
description:
Count active SAM.gov notices grouped by agency, sub-tier, office, NAICS, PSC, set-aside, notice type, place-of-performance state, contracting office state, or posted month. Accepts the same filters as search_opportunities, e.g. counts of open solicitations under one NAICS by set-aside, or which agencies posted the most sources sought notices this quarter.

Counts cover active notices in SAM.gov's public daily file, including notices posted in earlier fiscal years that remain active. This is not a complete historical archive; archived notices are not included.

name: get_data_status
description: Report source file names and dates, load times, row counts and coverage limitations for public opportunities, entity registrations and exclusions. Includes opportunity counts by type and last-load changes. Use it to judge how current results are.

name: search_entities
description: Look up SAM.gov entities by UEI or CAGE, or search the monthly public entity extract. All search filters combine. primary_naics matches the designated primary code; any_naics matches any listed code. Business types are self-selected; SBA source codes use sba_business_type_code (XX=HUBZone, A6=8(a)) and can remain after a certification exit date. Active registration does not establish current SBA certification; check certificationExitDate and confirm with SBA. Search defaults to Active; identifier lookups include any registration status unless explicitly filtered. Returns API-style public entity fields, up to 10 records per page. Entities who opted out of public display are not included in the hosted public mirror. Confirm current registration status on SAM.gov before relying on results.

legal_business_name.description: Partial legal business name match; no relevance ranking.

business_type_code.description: Self-selected 2-character SAM business type, e.g. QF (SDVOSB), A2, 8W, NB, A3.

sba_business_type_code.description: Monthly public SBA source code, not proof of current certification; XX=HUBZone, A6=8(a), A9=certified WOSB. Check certificationExitDate.

include_sections.description: Public sections only. Defaults to entityRegistration + coreData; entityRegistration is always included.

name: search_exclusions
description: Check SAM.gov public exclusion/debarment records by UEI, CAGE, or name. Filters combine. Searches the dated public extract, which is not a complete exclusion history; inactive or terminated historical records may be absent. Every result identifies the source file and date. No matches in the extract is not a live clearance or eligibility determination; confirm current status on SAM.gov.

entity_name.description: Firm or full individual name; case-insensitive literal substring match.

country.description: 3-character ISO alpha-3 country code, e.g. USA.
